capabilities.description: Capture complaints raised by school staff or parents, or entered by management on their behalf, and track each one through its full lifecycle to closure with status visible to management.
Automatically route each complaint to the appropriate technician or cleaner based on school site, trade/skill and workload, with manual override by management when needed.
Organise technician and cleaner teams per school, assign and track their work, and manage roles and access levels for management, field staff and complainants.
Per-site and portfolio-level dashboards across all 10 schools showing complaints, jobs, status and performance, for management oversight and control.
Scheduled and on-demand reporting on complaint volumes, closure times, team workload and per-school performance, including rollups across the estate.
Distinct access and permissions for management, technicians/cleaners and complainants, so each group sees and acts only on what they should.
Connection to the customer's existing ERP for the schools estate (currency AED). Ships as a marked placeholder until an ERP connector is available.
Connection to the customer's existing booking system so facility jobs and bookings stay aligned. Ships as a marked placeholder until a booking connector is available.
